required_checks: point is torsion-free and not small-order
strict Ed25519 verification API rejects non-canonical scalar and weak-key cases
exact input bytes SHA-256 equals consumer-selected snapshot digest
forbidden: acceptance based only on length or digest

required_checks: definite-length map and byte strings only
deterministic CBOR shortest encodings and key order
duplicate, unknown and missing labels rejected
no CBOR tags, floats, text keys or trailing bytes
x and y form a finite on-curve NIST P-256 point
exact COSE bytes SHA-256 equals consumer-selected snapshot digest
forbidden: acceptance based only on CBOR shape or digest

validation_order: strict candidate-specific parse and semantic point checks
